<a id="constancy-read-at-a-members-class-what-the-reach-asks-and-how-what-lies-outside-it-is-divided--于员之类之至终有常此及所须与类外之分"></a>
# Constancy read at a member's class, what the reach asks, and how what lies outside it is divided

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`constancy-read-at-a-members-class` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](constancy-read-at-a-members-class.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Constancy up to the net's end at a member's class carries the path's laws; the reach needs only that the class hold the effects of the member and its line. Where the member acts, it and alike occurrences must follow each other, so the division outside bears only through its own leaving effects.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Constancy up to the net's end asked only of the occurrences alike to a member is that condition at the member's class; constancy up to the net's end is that at every member's class. (`Becoming.«本类至终有常»`, `Becoming.«至终有常之逐类»`, `Becoming.«至终有常则本类至终有常»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
2. Each law of the path that asks constancy up to the net's end holds at the member's class, and PF's and PF2's forms are its corollaries: where a member conditions something and the class holds its effects, what is alike to it conditions only what is alike to it, everything downstream is on its line, and what a line reaches it carries on; holding the effects is everything downstream being alike; and what leaves the class follows every alike occurrence that conditions anything. (`Becoming.«出类不随则本类不至终有常»`, `Becoming.«本类出类随线»`, `Becoming.«本类出类随行»`, `Becoming.«本类常则闭当且仅当后皆同类»`, `Becoming.«本类常闭则后皆续»`, `Becoming.«本类常闭则所及皆及»`, `Becoming.«本类常闭则所缘同类»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
3. A line that ends while it still conditions something fails the condition at its class, and the condition asks more than that a line end only where the net does; the organism's class fails it at the first member in both finite witnesses, and in a witness where the class holds a member's effects but what follows them is not alike to it, the class fails it at the member. (`Becoming.CleanStep.ends_where_net_ends`, `Becoming.CleanStep.not_constant_at`, `Becoming.FiniteFamilies.member_class`, `Becoming.FiniteFamilies.member_not_constant_at`, `Becoming.FiniteSharedCondition.member_class`, `Becoming.FiniteSharedCondition.member_not_constant_at`, `Becoming.Inconstant.not_constant_at`, `Becoming.«亡而网续则本类不至终有常»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
4. How what lies outside is divided bears on the condition only through what is alike to an effect that leaves the member's class. Where the member conditions something, the condition is that whatever an alike occurrence conditions is alike to something the member conditions, and whatever the member conditions, each alike occurrence that conditions anything conditions something alike to it; so how what lies outside is divided bears on it only through what is alike to the member's own effects that leave the class, and is idle where the class holds the member's effects. (`Becoming.«外分唯系出类之同»`, `Becoming.«外分唯系己出之同»`, `Becoming.«本类常当且仅当与己相随»`, `Becoming.«闭则外分无关»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
5. Merging what lies outside keeps the condition, so where a predicate decides the member's class the split of that class from the rest asks least; under the split the condition is that what stays and what leaves follow every alike occurrence that conditions anything, and it holds where every such occurrence conditions something in the class and something outside. (`Becoming.«二分»`, `Becoming.«二分为类»`, `Becoming.«二分本类常当且仅当内外皆随»`, `Becoming.«内外皆缘则二分本类常»`, `Becoming.«外合不失本类之常»`, `Becoming.«异三则同»`, `Becoming.«本类之常至二分»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
6. Dividing what lies outside more finely can break the condition, even where every alike occurrence that conditions anything conditions something in the class and something outside; witnesses where the split meets it. (`Becoming.FinerOutside.Occ`, `Becoming.FinerOutside.finer`, `Becoming.FinerOutside.finer_class`, `Becoming.FinerOutside.finer_not_constant_at`, `Becoming.FinerOutside.inClass`, `Becoming.FinerOutside.kind`, `Becoming.FinerOutside.not_held`, `Becoming.FinerOutside.same_class`, `Becoming.FinerOutside.split_constant_at`, `Becoming.FinerOutside.step`, `Becoming.FinerWake.Occ`, `Becoming.FinerWake.both`, `Becoming.FinerWake.finer`, `Becoming.FinerWake.finer_class`, `Becoming.FinerWake.finer_not_constant_at`, `Becoming.FinerWake.inClass`, `Becoming.FinerWake.kind`, `Becoming.FinerWake.same_class`, `Becoming.FinerWake.split_constant_at`, `Becoming.FinerWake.step`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
7. Constancy up to the net's end can fail under the split while the member's class keeps the condition and holds the member's effects, where alike occurrences outside differ in what they condition in it; a finer division is constant up to the net's end. (`Becoming.UnevenOutside.Occ`, `Becoming.UnevenOutside.finer`, `Becoming.UnevenOutside.finer_class`, `Becoming.UnevenOutside.finer_constant_to_end`, `Becoming.UnevenOutside.held`, `Becoming.UnevenOutside.inClass`, `Becoming.UnevenOutside.kind`, `Becoming.UnevenOutside.same_class`, `Becoming.UnevenOutside.split_constant_at`, `Becoming.UnevenOutside.split_not_constant_to_end`, `Becoming.UnevenOutside.step`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar's vocabulary only.
8. Everything downstream of a member lies on its line under a class exactly where everything downstream of it is alike to it, that is, where the class holds the effects of the member and of each stage of its line, with no regularity assumed; so the reach needs the member's effects held, and it excludes a line from the member that ends while its last stage still conditions something, as the organism's class shows. With them, where the member conditions something, the condition at the member's class gives the reach and holds the effects of every alike occurrence; but the reach does not need it: in a witness the class holds the member's effects and everything downstream of the member lies on its line, while the class fails the condition at the member and does not hold the effects of an alike occurrence off that line. (`Becoming.FiniteFamilies.member_no_reach`, `Becoming.OtherLeaves.Occ`, `Becoming.OtherLeaves.all_alike`, `Becoming.OtherLeaves.inClass`, `Becoming.OtherLeaves.not_constant_at`, `Becoming.OtherLeaves.other_not_held`, `Becoming.OtherLeaves.other_off_line`, `Becoming.OtherLeaves.reach_without_condition`, `Becoming.OtherLeaves.reached`, `Becoming.OtherLeaves.reached_after`, `Becoming.OtherLeaves.reached_step`, `Becoming.OtherLeaves.step`, `Becoming.«亡而网续则后不皆续»`, `Becoming.«后皆同类则后皆续»`, `Becoming.«后皆续则所缘同于»`, `Becoming.«后皆续当且仅当后皆同类»`, `Becoming.«后皆续当且仅当自与线皆闭»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom and no premise beyond each law's own: for every carrier, relation and class, the split given by a decided predicate; the witnesses' nets supplied, with discrete steps and equality on their carriers.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That P2 should be read at one's own class, or with the split: that is argued as a reading, not proved.
- Which effects are one's own (the path's P4).
- That every occurrence alike to an actual agent that conditions anything both conditions something in the class of its line and leaves something outside it (a correspondence).
- That the split is the only division worth reading: finer divisions sort effects by kind, which other questions may need.
- That a class under which every line from a member ends only where the net does meets the condition at the member: in CleanStep it does not.
- That the class of an actual agent's line holds the effects of each stage of its line, with P2 or without it (a correspondence).

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · The model omits relations; what it omits it neither shows nor rules out.

<a id="next--下一步"></a>
## Next

Correspondences: whether actual agents meet P2 read with the split (each alike occurrence that conditions anything conditions something in the class and leaves something outside), and whether the class of an agent's line holds the effects of each stage of that line, as the path needs. Whether one presupposes P2 or only that, and the crux P4, are put to philosophers (P-20, questions 6 and 2).

<details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history</summary>

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Read with the path's P2: a self's regularity of its own is constancy up to the net's end at its own class. Of a self that acts and holds its effects it requires, however what one leaves out is divided, that every occurrence alike to it condition only what is alike to it, so its line continues from every alike occurrence that conditions anything. Of a self drawn by intention, read with the split of itself from the rest, it requires that where any alike occurrence conditions something in its class, or something outside, every alike occurrence that conditions anything does too, which holds where each both conditions something in its class and leaves something outside. The path itself asks less: that the class hold the effects of the self and of each stage of its line; given that the self holds its effects and acts, P2 gives this and also holds the effects of every occurrence alike to the self, off its line included. The reading is the AI's.
